INSERT INTO public.ticket_ai_predictions (
    ticket_id,
    status,
    category,
    priority,
    summary,
    provider,
    model,
    prompt_version,
    schema_version,
    error_code
)
VALUES ($1, 'pending', NULL, NULL, NULL, 'openai', $2, $3, $4, NULL)
RETURNING
    id AS prediction_id,
    ticket_id,
    status AS prediction_status,
    category,
    priority,
    summary,
    provider,
    model,
    prompt_version,
    schema_version,
    error_code,
    created_at AS prediction_created_at,
    updated_at AS prediction_updated_at;

parameters.jsCode:
const input = $input.first().json;
const ticketData = [
  '<untrusted_ticket_data>',
  'AREA:',
  input.ticket.requester_area,
  '',
  'TITLE:',
  input.ticket.title,
  '',
  'DESCRIPTION:',
  input.ticket.description,
  '</untrusted_ticket_data>',
].join('\n');

return [{
  json: {
    ticket_id: input.ticket_id,
    prediction_id: input.prediction_id,
    provider: input.provider,
    requested_model: 'gpt-5.6-luna',
    prompt_version: input.prompt_version,
    schema_version: input.schema_version,
    schema: input.schema,
    started_at_ms: Date.now(),
    request_body: {
      model: 'gpt-5.6-luna',
      instructions: input.prompt_content,
      input: [{ role: 'user', content: [{ type: 'input_text', text: ticketData }] }],
      text: { format: { type: 'json_schema', name: input.schema_version, schema: input.schema, strict: true } },
      reasoning: { effort: 'none' },
      store: false,
      max_output_tokens: 300,
    },
  },
}];

const request = $('Assert Production Single Request').first().json;
return [{ json: { ticket_id: request.ticket_id, prediction_id: request.prediction_id, error_code: 'AI_PROVIDER_ERROR' } }];

parameters.query:
WITH updated AS (
    UPDATE public.ticket_ai_predictions
    SET
        status = 'succeeded',
        category = $1,
        priority = $2,
        summary = $3,
        error_code = NULL,
        updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
    WHERE id = $4
      AND ticket_id = $5
      AND status = 'pending'
    RETURNING id, ticket_id, status, category, priority, summary, error_code
)
SELECT
    (SELECT count(*) FROM updated)::integer AS terminal_update_rows,
    (SELECT id FROM updated) AS prediction_id,
    (SELECT ticket_id FROM updated) AS ticket_id,
    (SELECT status FROM updated) AS prediction_status,
    (SELECT category FROM updated) AS category,
    (SELECT priority FROM updated) AS priority,
    (SELECT summary FROM updated) AS summary,
    (SELECT error_code FROM updated) AS error_code;

WITH updated AS (
    UPDATE public.ticket_ai_predictions
    SET
        status = 'failed',
        category = NULL,
        priority = NULL,
        summary = NULL,
        error_code = $1,
        updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
    WHERE id = $2
      AND ticket_id = $3
      AND status = 'pending'
    RETURNING id, ticket_id, status, category, priority, summary, error_code
)
SELECT
    (SELECT count(*) FROM updated)::integer AS terminal_update_rows,
    (SELECT id FROM updated) AS prediction_id,
    (SELECT ticket_id FROM updated) AS ticket_id,
    (SELECT status FROM updated) AS prediction_status,
    (SELECT category FROM updated) AS category,
    (SELECT priority FROM updated) AS priority,
    (SELECT summary FROM updated) AS summary,
    (SELECT error_code FROM updated) AS error_code;

parameters.query:
WITH inserted AS (
    INSERT INTO public.automation_events (
        ticket_id,
        prediction_id,
        rule_code,
        event_type,
        status,
        error_code
    )
    VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, 'skipped', NULL)
    ON CONFLICT (prediction_id, rule_code, event_type) DO NOTHING
    RETURNING id, ticket_id, prediction_id, rule_code, event_type, status, error_code
)
SELECT
    (SELECT count(*) FROM inserted)::integer AS event_insert_rows,
    (SELECT id FROM inserted) AS automation_event_id,
    (SELECT status FROM inserted) AS automation_event_status;

WITH inserted AS (
    INSERT INTO public.automation_events (
        ticket_id,
        prediction_id,
        rule_code,
        event_type,
        status,
        error_code
    )
    VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, 'pending', NULL)
    ON CONFLICT (prediction_id, rule_code, event_type) DO NOTHING
    RETURNING id, ticket_id, prediction_id, rule_code, event_type, status, error_code
)
SELECT
    (SELECT count(*) FROM inserted)::integer AS event_insert_rows,
    (SELECT id FROM inserted) AS automation_event_id,
    (SELECT ticket_id FROM inserted) AS ticket_id,
    (SELECT prediction_id FROM inserted) AS prediction_id,
    (SELECT status FROM inserted) AS automation_event_status;

WITH updated AS (
    UPDATE public.automation_events
    SET
        status = 'succeeded',
        error_code = NULL,
        updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
    WHERE id = $1
      AND prediction_id = $2
      AND status = 'pending'
    RETURNING id, status, error_code
)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM updated)::integer AS terminal_update_rows;

WITH updated AS (
    UPDATE public.automation_events
    SET
        status = 'failed',
        error_code = 'TELEGRAM_SEND_FAILED',
        updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
    WHERE id = $1
      AND prediction_id = $2
      AND status = 'pending'
    RETURNING id, status, error_code
)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM updated)::integer AS terminal_update_rows;

WITH inserted_ticket AS (
    INSERT INTO public.tickets (
        requester_email,
        requester_area,
        title,
        description
    )
    VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4)
    RETURNING id, status, created_at, updated_at
),
inserted_prediction AS (
    INSERT INTO public.ticket_ai_predictions (
        ticket_id,
        status,
        category,
        priority,
        summary,
        provider,
        model,
        prompt_version,
        schema_version,
        error_code
    )
    SELECT
        id,
        'pending',
        NULL,
        NULL,
        NULL,
        $5,
        $6,
        $7,
        $8,
        NULL
    FROM inserted_ticket
    RETURNING id, ticket_id, status, category, priority, summary, provider, model, prompt_version, schema_version, error_code, created_at, updated_at
)
SELECT
    t.id AS ticket_id,
    t.status AS ticket_status,
    t.created_at AS ticket_created_at,
    t.updated_at AS ticket_updated_at,
    p.id AS prediction_id,
    p.status AS prediction_status,
    p.category,
    p.priority,
    p.summary,
    p.provider,
    p.model,
    p.prompt_version,
    p.schema_version,
    p.error_code,
    p.created_at AS prediction_created_at,
    p.updated_at AS prediction_updated_at,
    $9::text AS test_mode
FROM inserted_ticket t
CROSS JOIN inserted_prediction p;

SELECT
    p.id AS prediction_id,
    p.ticket_id,
    p.status AS prediction_status,
    p.category,
    p.priority,
    p.summary,
    p.provider,
    p.model,
    p.prompt_version,
    p.schema_version,
    p.error_code,
    p.created_at AS prediction_created_at,
    p.updated_at AS prediction_updated_at,
    t.status AS ticket_status,
    $3::text AS test_mode
FROM public.ticket_ai_predictions p
JOIN public.tickets t ON t.id = p.ticket_id
WHERE p.id = $1
  AND p.ticket_id = $2;

const items = $input.all();
if (items.length !== 1 || items[0].json.valid !== true) throw new Error('AI_RESPONSE_INVALID');

const result = items[0].json;
return [{
  json: {
    ticket_id: result.ticket_id,
    prediction_id: result.prediction_id,
    ticket_status: result.ticket_status,
    prediction_created_at: result.prediction_created_at,
    prediction_pending_updated_at: result.prediction_pending_updated_at,
    pending_verified_before_openai: result.pending_verified_before_openai,
    provider: result.provider,
    requested_model: result.requested_model,
    reported_model: result.reported_model,
    prompt_version: result.prompt_version,
    schema_version: result.schema_version,
    category: result.data.category,
    priority: result.data.priority,
    summary: result.data.summary,
    structured_output: 'PASS',
    deterministic_validator: 'PASS',
    response_status: result.response_status,
    input_tokens: result.input_tokens,
    cached_input_tokens: result.cached_input_tokens,
    output_tokens: result.output_tokens,
    total_tokens: result.total_tokens,
    latency_ms: result.latency_ms,
    http_request_item_count: result.http_request_item_count,
  },
}];
